name: Content Security Policy
description: Implement strict Content Security Policy on all renderer contexts. No inline scripts, no eval(), no unsafe-eval, no unsafe-inline. Sources are strictly whitelisted. CSP violations produce receipts.
purpose: Prevent XSS and code injection attacks by enforcing a strict CSP across all renderer contexts that blocks inline scripts, eval, and restricts source origins.
acceptanceCriteria: All renderer contexts have a strict CSP header/meta tag
CSP blocks inline scripts and eval (no unsafe-inline, no unsafe-eval)
Script and style sources are strictly whitelisted
CSP violation reports are captured and produce security event receipts
CSP cannot be overridden or disabled from renderer context
CSP policy is versioned and auditable
